title: Shoot'em up construction kit
author: paulvern
selftext:
I'm definitely not young anymore and I played all CAVE classics such as *DoDonPachi* and *ESP.Ra.De.*, alongside the action of *Commando* on the C64, I really loved them.  
So I decided to try to contruct a SHMUP Construction Set working completely in the browser. As you may imagine, I did not write a lot of code myself, but I manually edited almost all parts of this project.

Design enemy waves, tweak bullet patterns with live previews, draw tile maps and animate your own pixel-art sprites. Add MP3 or MIDI music, test your game instantly, then export it as **one standalone, playable HTML file**.

**Features**

* **Two game modes:** vertical bullet hell and top-down run-and-gun.
* **Visual editors:** wave timelines, enemy formations, trajectories and bullet patterns.
* **Tile Map Editor:** build scrolling worlds with obstacles, hazards and enemy placements.
* **Animated Sprite Editor:** drawing tools, multiple frames, onion skin and PNG import.
* **Multiple stages:** create complete games with different maps, music and bosses.
* **Arcade mechanics:** scoring chains, grazing, power-ups, bombs, grenades and bosses with multiple phases and destructible parts.
* **Extensive content library:** 214 sprites, 156 enemy types, 53 bullet-pattern presets and 6 bosses.
* **Built-in audio:** 13 music tracks and 29 synthesized sound effects, plus MP3/MIDI import.
* **Six playable demos:** military action, psychic urban battles and space-opera adventures.
* **Interface in 18 languages**, with guided tutorials in English and Italian.

**Works offline. No installation or server required.** Open the single-file editor in your browser and start building. Exported games include keyboard, mouse and touch controls, so you can share your creations as standalone HTML games.

Do you want to give it a try? Try the full working version here:  
[https://paulvern.itch.io/shootem-up-construction-kit](https://paulvern.itch.io/shootem-up-construction-kit)
